set.body:
Goal: finish the useful ~/code/volregger port as an idiomatic Oderskyan Scala 3 motion module, not an R API clone.

Scope: shared typed core, generated parity fixtures, spline/acquisition timing, IC/whitening policy, deterministic parallel execution, JVM IO/CLI/report adapters, real-data differential benchmarks, and final API/docs release gate.

Done when: public surfaces are algebraic and inspectable, invalid states are represented with types or MotionError, shared code remains JVM/Scala.js portable, and completion is verified by motionJVM/test, motionJS/test, testAll where feasible, plus documented benchmark evidence.
set.title: EPIC: Complete volregger motion port as idiomatic Scala 3
